messages:
Maria G: Heads-up—I'm starting the tf module refactor that splits network module into network-core + network-aws. Planning to move provider blocks up to root and consolidate provider pins. Need quick sanity check on lockfile regen and k8s secret path wiring. TL;DR: will run lockfile regen in CI and create compatibility shim for < 0.14 state. Anyone seen issues with provider mirror or registry overrides?
Andrew R: +1 for root providers. A couple things: keep provider aliases for cross-account resources. Also ensure `terraform providers lock` targets all required provider versions. CI should fail if lockfile diff isn't regenerated. :thumbsup:
Infra CI Bot: [ci] plan job started for branch refactor/module-split (job id 4123). Running `terraform init -lockfile=readonly` on staging.
Kevin L: One quick snippet we used earlier for state migration:
```
terraform state mv module.old.module.aws_instance.example module.new.module.aws_instance.example
```
Do that in a canary seat first.
Lina P: For secrets: don't change k8s secret paths in-place. Add a fallback read in app config: check `k8s/<old-path>` then `k8s/<new-path>`. That avoids rollout pain.
Maria G: Good call. I'll add a compat layer in the module outputs + docs. Also plan to pin `registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws` to 4.60.0 in the lockfile. Any objections to 4.60 vs 4.59?
Andrew R: I think 4.60 fixes an EC2 attach bug. We pinned to 4.59 earlier because of a regression. If you can run our smokeplan against 4.60 in a sandbox, go for it.
SRE-Oncall: Be mindful of stateful resources (rds, elb). Add maintenance window to rollout and notify #incidents if DB restarts possible.
Maria G: Will do. My plan: run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` in sandbox, push lockfile update, open canary PR targeting staging, run smoke plan + apply, then roll to prod. Any extra signoffs needed?
Andrew R: Add a quick `tfsec` and `terraform fmt` check, and at least one infra reviewer (Kevin).
Kevin L: I'll review the plan. Assign to me when PR is up.
Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled for staging: branch refactor/module-split, window 23:00 UTC. :rocket:
